records.officialDescription:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About the role

HackerRank is advancing AI-driven Technical Interviewing, assessment of Integrity, and the measurement of Engineering skill to use AI assistance effectively in the agentic era. We are looking for research-oriented M.S./Ph.D. scholars to explore and develop novel Deep Learning architectures and build efficient, trustworthy AI systems. A key research direction is to develop a model-agnostic external Recursive Reasoning Engine that enables smaller models (SLM/SSM/Hybrid etc.) to solve complex, repository-grounded software engineering tasks with greater effectiveness, traceability, and lower inference cost.

Open problems

The agentic era is reshaping every layer of the hiring stack. These are some of the core problems you’ll be working across, none of them fully solved.

• Chakra: Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end.

• Integrity: Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up.

• Evaluation: Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet.

Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time.

What you will do

• Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures.

• Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches.

• Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures.

• Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation

• Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization.

• Design rigorous experiments, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to validate research hypotheses.

• Translate cutting-edge research into scalable, production-grade AI systems.

Who you are

• M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D. in AI/ML or related disciplines.

• 2-3 years of experience in Deep Learning, Machine Learning, or Applied AI Research.

• Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Optimization, and Deep Learning algorithms.

• Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch/JAX, with hands-on model development experience.

• Demonstrated ability to implement, reproduce, and extend research papers, including building neural architectures from scratch.

• Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, benchmarking, and statistical validation.

• Demonstrated research aptitude through publications, open-source contributions etc.

Even better if you have

• Understanding of Evaluation Benchmarks for S/W Engineering Tasks and Human-Agent Collaborations

• Familiarity with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, and scalable ML infrastructure.

You will thrive here if you

• You enjoy solving open-ended research problems and challenging established assumptions.

records.title: Finance and Strategy Data Analyst
records.officialDescription:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

We are building an elite team to drive financial insight and strategy at Stripe. The Corporate Finance & Strategy team brings understanding and predictability to Stripe’s financials, and we work together with our key business partners to accelerate long term growth for Stripe.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

• Partner with F&S and the Business to drive the long-term success of Stripe

• Ensure month close processes get done efficiently, accurately, and on time

• Partner across Finance, eg. Strategic Sourcing 

• Work cross functionally to identify important strategy questions and answer them with data

• Build financial forecasts and targets, track performance, and understand deviations from actuals to drive strategy and operational rigor

• Gain deep knowledge and understanding of Stripe's business performance across geographies and user segments

• Automating away recurring work by utilizing AI

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Experience in month end close processes and have demonstrated experience working closely and successfully across the other functions of the Finance Org (eg., Accounting, Tax, Treasury)

• Experience running recurring processes and organizing cross-functional partners and stakeholders to deliver materials on time (e.g. enabling, tracking, monitoring status, problem solving the month end close process; driving successful continuous improvement initiatives as it relates to domain of expertise)

• A strong understanding of accounting, accruals, and opex management

• Experience with financial analysis, financial forecasting, BvA (variance analysis), and other financial concepts

• Experience working on ambiguous problems and driving solutions/projects independently

• Ability to automate and use AI to streamline recurring tasks/analyses, in order to free up time to work on more strategic and higher impact work

• Experience building dashboards and data visualization tools from scratch

• A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners and department leads. You are seen as a trusted and objective advisor

• An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality

• A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision

• Experience working in a global capacity (this team will work will all regions)

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in a strategic finance function at a high-growth tech company, preferably in the payments/fintech space

Technical Account Engineer - I 

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

About the Role

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

What You Will Actually Do

• Own your named accounts technically. Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.

• Get customers using the platform extensively. Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.

• Craft success plans that can be measured. Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.

• See trouble coming. Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.

• Run the cadence. Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.

• Help the accounts grow. Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.

• Make the team better. Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

Where and When

• This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.

• Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.

• You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

What You Will Bring

• 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.

• Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.

• A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.

• Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.

• A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.

• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See

records.title: Data Engineer
records.officialDescription:
Job Summary:

Would you like to be part of building the data pipeline for the entire organization? Help source, organize and provide accessibility to numerous engineering teams, business stakeholders and external partners? GLG is building a next generation platform to transform the existing way we deal with data across the organization.

As a data engineer you will:

• Cleanse, normalize and enhance quality for both the existing operational systems as well as new data sources that flow through the data platform.

• Build, monitor, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL and Airflow.

• Design and optimize tables, datasets, and transformations in Snowflake.

• Develop and support data ingestion workflows, including API integrations, file ingestion, and database connectors.

• Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across pipelines.

• Work in an Agile environment and collaborate with engineering, analytics, and product teams.

• Use integration tools (e.g., Fivetran, Workato, Informatica, etc.) to onboard new data sources.

You will have:

• 1-3 years of experience as a Data Engineer.

• Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, Python, SQL, and Airflow.

• Experience building data ingestion pipelines across APIs, files, and databases.

• Strong SQL, Data Modeling skills, plus a solid understanding of ETL/ELT concepts.

• Experience working in Agile teams (Scrum, sprint planning, etc.).

• Experience with data integration tools is preferred.

• Knowledge of data engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source management, build processes, testing, and operations.

Nice to Have:

• Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS preferred).

• Experience with Git, CI/CD.

About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group

GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers-from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s-with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.

At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.

We are a global team of pragmatic problem-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.

Gerson Lehrman Group, Inc. (“GLG”) is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, race, religion, color, marital status, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

Instawork’s on-demand labor marketplace is uniquely valuable for robotics and physical AI. We’re working with leading frontier labs to create the highest-quality, highest-diversity datasets for training robotics foundation models. Instawork Robotics is the human advantage in the robotics revolution. 

We are seeking a highly skilled, Field Engineering Technician to manage the maintenance, calibration, and local deployment of a fleet of 600 custom wearable camera rigs. Unlike standard IT support, this role sits at the intersection of precision electronics, mechanical assembly, and field operations. You will be the primary guardian of our hardware integrity, ensuring that high-stakes egocentric data collection continues without interruption across various deployment sites.

About IRL

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.

- Track repaired, failed, and pending devices in the service tracker.
- Support field teams with remote and on-site hardware troubleshooting when required.
- Coordinate with the engineering and inventory management teams to resolve hardware-related issues.
- Follow electrostatic discharge (ESD) and safe-handling procedures when working with electronic components.
- Assist with managing spare parts, cameras, sensors, cables, connectors, and other hardware inventory.
- Prepare service reports and communicate recurring hardware problems to the engineering team.
- Support the testing and validation of new devices, components, and hardware revisions.

records.officialDescription:

Rig / Productivity Team - Intern

Function: Operations - Rig Data Processing & Productivity

Work Mode: On-site

Shift: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

Role Overview

The Rig / Productivity Team is responsible for ensuring that recorded field data is uploaded, reconciled, validated, and made ready for reuse. The role combines two critical functions: processing SD card data and reviewing recorded videos to determine whether the data is valid.

The team ensures that every uploaded batch is accounted for, SD cards are returned to inventory within the expected turnaround time, and valid-data assessments are completed accurately. No shortcuts in data handling, no unexplained pending work, and no compromise on data quality.

What You'll Own

- Rig: Complete the upload-to-return cycle for SD cards, ensuring data is uploaded successfully before cards are formatted and returned to inventory.

- Productivity: Review recorded videos and accurately determine valid vs. invalid data.

- Maintain complete visibility of pending work, turnaround time, and any data-related issues.

- Ensure that every batch is processed in the correct sequence and that no data is skipped or misrepresented.

Key Responsibilities

1. SD Card Data Processing & Upload

- Receive reconciled SD cards from the inventory team.

- Upload recorded data to the cloud as per the defined process.

- Verify that uploads are completed successfully before proceeding to formatting.

- Track uploaded, pending, and failed uploads.

- Report any corrupt cards, upload failures, or other data-related issues.

2. SD Card Formatting & Return to Inventory

- Format SD cards only after successful upload confirmation.

- Ensure formatted cards are returned to inventory on the same day.

- Maintain accurate records of cards processed, formatted, and returned.

- Follow the complete upload → format → return sequence without skipping steps.

3. Video Review & Valid-Data Assessment

- Review recorded videos to determine whether the data is valid.

- Identify and record valid vs. invalid data accurately.

- Track videos checked against pending videos.

- Maintain valid-data percentages at card and batch level.

- Escalate unclear or questionable data for further review.

4. Reconciliation, Tracking & Reporting

- Maintain daily visibility of SD cards and batches across the processing cycle.

- Track turnaround from reconciled → uploaded → formatted → returned to inventory.

- Maintain clean and complete Google Sheets trackers.

- Report pending work, delays, and card/data errors.

- Ensure all uploaded batches are accounted for and their validation status is recorded.

5. Process Discipline & Quality

- Follow the defined upload, formatting, and video-review processes consistently.

- Avoid skipping, rushing, or incorrectly marking data to clear backlogs.

- Maintain accuracy during repetitive, high-volume video review.

- Ensure that data handling and reporting remain honest and traceable.

Skills & Requirements

Mandatory

- Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with Google Sheets.

- Comfortable handling SD cards, card readers, and computer-based data transfers.

- Ability to follow technical processes and checklists accurately.

- High attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to perform repetitive video review without compromising quality.

Preferred

Experience in data processing, video review, quality checking, or operations.…

records.title: Quality Check Intern - Hardware
records.officialDescription:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

Quality Control Intern - Hardware

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we're looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

Role Overview

The Quality Control Intern - Hardware is the checkpoint every recording rig passes through, in both directions. When rigs return from the field, you inspect their condition, run a functional check, and capture a short test recording that you review to confirm the cameras, footage, audio, and storage are all working. Before any rig goes back out, you give the final sign-off that it is field-ready.

This is a small role with an outsized impact: a rig that leaves your desk in a bad state means a Field Officer travels to a business, records for hours, and returns with unusable or missing data - a full day lost, and sometimes a burned business relationship. Your job is to make sure that never happens. Precision, consistency, and discipline are the whole game here.

What You'll Own

• Nothing goes to field without your approval; nothing comes back without your inspection and log.

• You are the last line of defense on rig quality before it reaches a business.

Key Responsibilities

1. Inbound Inspection (rigs returning from cities)

• Receive rigs and accessories (cameras, SD cards, card readers, cables, mounts) as they return from the field

• Check physical condition - damage, loose mounts, worn cables, cleanliness - and log it

• Verify all issued components are present against the checkout record; flag anything missing

2. Functional QC & Test Recording

• Power up each rig and confirm cameras open, storage is available, and the device is charged/charging correctly

• Capture a short test recording and review it: cameras correctly aligned, footage clear and stable, audio present, timestamps correct

• Confirm the SD card reads correctly, the previous session's data has been offloaded, and the card is cleared and ready for reuse

• Only mark a rig "field-ready" once every check passes

3. Outbound Approval (clearing rigs for field)

• Give the final go/no-go before a rig is handed to a Field Officer

• Ensure the rig leaves fully charged, correctly configured, and with the right accessories

• Sign off in the tracker so every field-ready rig is traceable to your check

4. Fault Handling & Escalation

• Quarantine any rig that fails QC so it cannot accidentally go to field

• Log the exact fault clearly (which component, what's wrong) and escalate hardware faults to the Hardware/IT team

• Follow up so repaired rigs are re-checked before they re-enter circulation

5. Documentation & Discipline

• Maintain clean, complete QC records in Google Sheets - every rig, every check, pass/fail, date/time, and reason

• Keep the QC and quarantine areas organized and controlled

• Follow the QC checklist exactly, every single time - no shortcuts, no assumptions

Skills & Requirements

Mandatory

• Some technical or hardware familiarity - comfortable handling phones/cameras, SD cards, cables, and basic device settings

• Basic computer…

• 2+ years of experience with containerization technologies, including Docker.

• 1+ years of experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.

• Experience managing databases - PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB, MongoDB.

About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role: 

The DDQ Analyst plays an important role in supporting AlphaSense’s global sales process by responding to client Due Diligence Questionnaires accurately, consistently, and on time. This role sits at the intersection of IT Security, Compliance, Sales, Cyber, and Risk, giving the analyst strong exposure to how a global SaaS company supports enterprise customers, protects data, and manages compliance requirements.

This is a high-volume, process-driven role suited to someone with hands-on DDQ experience who thrives on structure, attention to detail, and a fast-paced environment. The analyst will use approved response content, documented procedures, and AI-assisted tools to move DDQs through the workflow efficiently, applying sound judgment on which questions can be answered from approved sources and which require escalation to a subject matter expert. The role is responsible for the accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of client-facing security and compliance responses that directly support deal timelines.

What You’ll Do: 

• Support AlphaSense’s global sales process by completing client DDQs accurately, consistently, and within agreed turnaround times.

• Review incoming DDQs, understand the nature of the request, and process them by following established standard operating procedures, templates, and the approved internal knowledge base.

• Retrieve and apply pre-approved, standardized answers to client questionnaires, ensuring each response is accurate, consistent, and aligned with approved company positions.

• Use AI-assisted tooling to help draft, match, and assemble questionnaire responses, while carefully reviewing all AI-generated output for accuracy before it is finalized.

• Identify questions that fall outside the SOP or do not have an approved answer in the knowledge base, and escalate them promptly and clearly to the appropriate subject matter expert rather than improvising a response.

• Work cross-functionally with teams such as Information Security, Engineering, Privacy, Legal, Product, and Sales to help move client requests forward and support deal timelines.

• Protect confidential client and company information at all times, handling sensitive security, compliance, and commercial data in line with confidentiality and data-handling policies.

• Maintain accurate trackers, records, and DDQ pipeline updates to ensure requests are monitored, prioritized, and completed within defined turnaround times.

• Help maintain the “Source of Truth” repository of standardized answers by flagging outdated content and adding newly approved responses under the guidance of senior team members.

• Manage access requests for the AlphaSense Trust Library by following the documented process, enabling clients to self-serve standard security and compliance documentation.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Database Engineer with 1 year to 2 years of experience in managing databases in either on-premises or AWS cloud environments. The ideal candidate should possess foundational knowledge of database administration, cloud services, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and operational support. The role involves supporting the provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, backup, security, and optimisation of database platforms such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, and AWS RDS (PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL). • Basic administration knowledge of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, or AWS RDS.

• Experience managing databases in on-premises or AWS cloud environments.

• Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and Ansible for configuration management.

• Knowledge of Linux administration, SQL, database backup & recovery concepts.

• Experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog and AWS CloudWatch.

• Understanding of database performance monitoring, high availability, security, and troubleshooting.

• Familiarity with Git, scripting (Shell/Bash or Python), and DevOps automation practices.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

• Internship experience in database or cloud technologies will be considered.

• ·AWS Cloud Practitioner / AWS Associate certification is an added advantage.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Good verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to learn new database and cloud technologies quickly and work effectively in a team environment.

Karya's AI Evaluations team measures how well AI models serve people in the languages and contexts global benchmarks miss. We work with partners including Anthropic and Microsoft Research, alongside government and civil society, running evaluations on our own platform with native speakers and domain experts across India and beyond. Our benchmarks, leaderboards and reports aim to help model developers and decision-makers understand where models work well and where they fall short.

• Quality control: run automated checks on annotation data and flag anomalies before they affect results.

• Infrastructure: build and maintain tested, documented tooling for data processing, QC and analysis, with logged configs for reproducibility.

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP or a related field.

• Strong Python and comfort working with data (pandas or similar).

• Working knowledge of LLMs and modern ML, and familiarity with calling models via APIs.

• Solid foundation in probability and statistics.

• Methodical debugging skills, and willingness to dig into unfamiliar systems when something breaks.

Strong differentiators

• Experience with ML projects involving evaluation, annotation or human feedback data.

• Exposure to speech or multilingual NLP, especially Indian languages.

• Experience with GPU inference, cloud tooling or Android/app debugging.

Mindset

• Takes ownership of work end to end, knowing that reliable operations are what make evaluations trustworthy.

• Thrives in interdisciplinary teams spanning engineering, research, social science, operations and domain experts.

• Comfortable with ambiguity, messy data and shifting priorities.

• Cares about building AI that works for the people it is meant to serve.

records.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Agents
records.officialDescription:
About Prodigal

Prodigal is the connected AI platform leading financial institutions use to run their operations.

We work with banks, lenders, credit unions, and other financial companies that lend money to people and manage those relationships over time.

These institutions make millions of high-stakes decisions every day. Who should they reach? When should they reach them? What should they say or offer? When should a case move to a human? How should that change based on the borrower, the account, previous interactions, and the regulations involved?

Getting those decisions right requires a deep understanding of the people, processes, rules, and edge cases behind them.

Prodigal has spent the last eight years building that understanding. More than a billion interactions between financial institutions and their customers have shaped the intelligence, guardrails, and AI agents we now run in production across North America.

Today, our AI agents analyze conversations, capture context, guide human agents, decide the next action, conduct customer conversations, orchestrate outreach, and help people complete payments and resolutions. They are connected, so what is learned in one interaction can inform what happens next.

We are expanding this swarm of AI agents across more of the work financial institutions do: originations, document processing, back-office workflows, servicing, and other critical operations where money, identity, people, and regulation intersect.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Accel, and Menlo Ventures, and work with 100+ financial institutions across North America. Listen directly from our CTO, Cofounder - Sangram Raje

What You’ll Do

• Build and deploy LLM-powered AI agents (including voice agents) in production, designed for real-world use cases

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI systems - from problem scoping and design to deployment, monitoring, and continuous iteration

• Design and optimize prompts, RAG pipelines, and evaluation frameworks to improve accuracy, latency, and reliability

• Work directly with customers and Implementation Managers (IMs) to understand workflows, solve real-world problems, and drive successful go-lives and iterations 

What We’re Looking For

• 2+ years experience in Product backend / AI engineering

• Strong in Python + SQL

• Experience or exposure to LLMs, RAG, or prompt engineering

• High ownership, ability to work in ambiguity and ship fast

• Comfortable working with customers and cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualification

• B.Tech, BE, or M.Tech in Computer Science or a related discipline, with 1-3 years of relevant experience

Bonus

• Experience with production LLM systems / AI agents

• Familiarity with evaluation, agent tooling, or voice AI

• Experience with Databricks, MongoDB, or distributed systems

• Startup or customer-facing engineering experience

Why This Role

• Work on real production AI systems (not demos)

• End-to-end ownership and fast iteration cycles

• Direct impact on enterprise customers and business outcomes

Mode of Work - In-Office
From day 1, Prodigal has been defined by talented, humble, and hungry leaders and we want this mindset and culture to continue to blossom from top to bottom in the company. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to work in a fast-paced, intellectually-stimulating environment where you will be pushed to grow, then please reach out because we are looking to build a transformational company that reinvents one of the biggest industries in the US.

To learn more about us - please visit the following:

Our Story - https://www.prodigaltech.com/our-story

What shapes our thinking - https://link.prodigaltech.com/our-thesis

Our website - https://www.prodigaltech.com/

records.officialDescription:
Company Overview

At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Computer Vision AI & ML Engineer to design, build, and deploy advanced perception systems for real-world robotics and automation. You will work across the full machine learning lifecycle-model development, data strategy, evaluation, and production integration-to deliver robust, high-performance vision capabilities. This role combines applied research with hands-on engineering and offers the opportunity to influence both architecture and roadmap decisions.

Responsibilities

• Develop and optimize deep learning models for object detection, segmentation, tracking, and 3D scene understanding using multi-modal sensor data.

• Build scalable pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment into real-world and real-time systems.

• Design labeling strategies and tooling for automated annotation, QA workflows, dataset management, augmentation, and versioning.

• Implement monitoring and reliability frameworks, including uncertainty estimation, failure detection, and automated performance reporting.

• Conduct proof-of-concept experiments to evaluate new algorithms and perception techniques; translate research insights into practical prototypes.

• Collaborate with robotics, systems, and simulation teams to integrate perception models into production pipelines and improve end-to-end performance.

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX).

• Background in computer vision tasks such as detection, segmentation, tracking, or 3D scene understanding.

• Proficiency in Python; familiarity with C++ is a plus.

• Experience building training pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and ML deployment workflows.

• Knowledge of 3D geometry, sensor processing, or multi-sensor fusion (RGB-D, LiDAR, stereo).

• Experience with data annotation tools, dataset management, and augmentation techniques.

• Familiarity with robotics, simulation environments (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, Blender), or real-time systems.

• Understanding of uncertainty modeling, reliability engineering, or ML monitoring/MLOps practices.

records.title: [Backend, Onsite] Software Engineering Intern
records.officialDescription:
About Enterpret

At Enterpret, we are building the customer intelligence platform that turns millions of raw, messy pieces of customer feedback into a structured, queryable source of truth, solving complex problems in natural language processing, serverless computing, and real-time analytics by applying first-principle thinking to systems that operate at massive scale.

We are AI-native to the core. Our models, pipelines, and infrastructure are designed around AI from the ground up, and our engineers ship these features to production at scale. Our investors are Kleiner Perkins and Sequoia Capital, and a few of our customers are Canva, Notion, and Wispr Flow, among many other customer-centric product orgs.

We love working with folks who are resourceful, curious, and take ownership of their work. Our internship program isn't about side projects, it's a launchpad. You'll take on meaningful problems, learn quickly, and directly impact the systems our customers rely on every day.

Our engineering culture is built around leveraging and contributing to open-source tools. We aim to build upon and improve state-of-the-art systems in our field of work.

Read more about our team, core values, and operating principles - here.

What You'll Do

Our backend team is small but exceptionally strong, so you'll learn fast and get real ownership early, with experienced engineers alongside you the whole way. You'll get to build things from scratch and see how your systems hold up in the real world, with all its messy data, unexpected user behavior, and edge cases.

And when something breaks (it happens to all of us), you'll dig in with the team to make it faster and more resilient than before.

• Join our system design discussions: sit in on internal design and implementation conversations and contribute your ideas.

• Take ideas from concept to production: build real solutions with guidance, not just closing tickets off a backlog.

• Develop on serverless architectures using AWS, building scalable backend components that stand up to real-world use.

• Help build proof-of-concepts for new backend + AI feature integrations, from model output to real-time inference.

• Work closely with the engineers building our AI-native platform and learn how backend architecture supports AI features end to end.

What It Takes

• Onsite in Bangalore is a must-have: you're able and willing to work from our Bangalore office in person.

• Pursuing a degree in Computer Science or Engineering from a Tier 1 college.

• Strong programming fundamentals in any modern language.

• At least one prior internship in a relevant engineering or backend/AI role.

• Genuine interest in distributed systems, serverless computing, and AI-powered product features.

• Sharp problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills, and an eagerness to learn how backend architecture supports AI from model training to real-time inference.

• Bonus: open-source contributions or backend/AI project experience.

Why Enterpret?

• Real Impact: Your code ships to production and reaches features used by companies like Canva and Notion.

• Ownership: Real autonomy and ownership of what you build, with support when you need it.

• Learn by Doing: Get hands-on with AI, data, and scalable systems that most interns only read about.

• Mentorship: Learn directly from engineers who have scaled AI-native systems, plus L&D resources in backend + AI.

• Culture: An open, collaborative, builder-first environment where it's safe to experiment, ask questions, and grow.

• Rewards: Competitive internship stipend, and a potential Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on your performance.

What We Value

At Enterpret, we operate with a deep sense of ownership, we play for the team and do what it takes to win together. We care personally for our teammates while pushing each other with honest, actionable feedback. Above all…

records.title: Machine Learning Intern
records.officialDescription:
About Us

Enterpret is redefining how businesses understand and act on customer feedback. We are building an AI-native platform that centralises feedback from every source surveys, reviews, support tickets, communities and turns it into clear, actionable insights that drive business growth.

We are trusted by some of the world’s most customer-obsessed companies like Canva, Descript, Notion, Perplexity and many more, and backed by leading investors like Kleiner Perkins, Canaan Partners, and Peak XV Partners. Our mission: to unlock the voice of the customer for every product team on the planet.

What You’ll Do ?

At Enterpret, our internship program isn’t about side projects, it’s a launchpad for future team members. You’ll work on problems as deep and complex as you can handle, directly impacting the systems our customers rely on. 

As a Machine Learning Intern, you will:

•  Build and prototype LLM-backed features alongside senior engineers - retrieval pipelines, agents, evaluation harnesses, or hybrid patterns - and ship a meaningful slice of one into production by the end of the internship.

• Contribute to eval rubrics, test plans, and quality dashboards that make AI feature quality measurable, and run evals on shipped systems.

• Write clean, testable Python in our production stack, add tests that catch regressions, and help monitor and harden systems already in production.

• Debug failures across data, infra, model, and prompt logic with your mentor, and write up what you learn so the team learns with you.

How do you want to pay? It’s a question you’ve answered on-screen or in-person thousands of times, but your choices have always been limited. Imagine the flexibility to pay however you want - credit, debit, multiple currencies, frequent flyer miles, loyalty points, or digital payments - all on the same card or digital wallet. Sound impossible? Episode Six makes the seemingly impossible happen every day. 

We’re a global provider of API-based payment processing and wallet management infrastructure. We’re 100% cloud-native, hyper-configurable, and a “Top 10 Place to Work in Fintech.” And we’re changing how people think about payments. 

Today, we’re powering payments for one of the world’s largest banks and airlines and numerous innovative fintechs. E6 is headquartered in Austin with offices in Tokyo, Singapore, Brisbane, and London. We provide technology for clients in 24 countries on four continents. Since 2018 when we launched with HSBC, we have grown more than 10x. 

Interested in redefining what’s possible in payments? Join Episode Six today.  

What we’re hiring for:  

We are a growing fintech organization looking to add a Security Operations Centre (SOC) Graduate Trainee for our Security Team. 

Role Overview: 

The Security Operations Centre (SOC) Graduate Trainee role is a hands-on information security position, working in a security sensitive, hybrid cloud environment. It requires configuring and using security tools, performing day-to-day security operations, maintaining documentation, and working with internal and external parties. 

Strong candidates bring an understanding of common technical security controls and how they are applied to ensure the ongoing security of critical assets in a 24/7 environment. 

What you’ll be responsible for in this role: 

• Monitor, investigate, triage, and respond to security alerts and incidents generated by security monitoring platforms.  

• Administer and maintain security technologies, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and vulnerability scanning solutions. 

• Conduct routine security log reviews across production, disaster recovery, development, cloud, and corporate environments.  

• Perform security event analysis to identify suspicious activity, indicators of compromise, and emerging threats.  

• Support vulnerability management activities, including vulnerability assessment, risk analysis, remediation tracking, and reporting.  

• Perform security compliance reviews of critical infrastructure, including user access management, privileged account management, patching, firewall configurations, endpoint security controls, and system hardening standards.  

• Support incident response and investigation activities, including evidence collection, documentation, escalation, and lessons learned reviews.  

• Deliver security awareness and operational security training to employees where appropriate.  

• Participate in an on-call, shift, and weekend support rota to ensure continuous security monitoring and response capabilities. 

What experiences and skills are necessary to be successful in this role:  

Mandatory 

• 0-2 years of experience with a primary focus in Information Security 

• Formal security certification, or working towards certification 

• Good understanding of security controls  

• Knowledge of security capabilities available in Linux, Windows, and AWS Cloud Computing environments 

• Good understanding of network security tools such as firewalls and NIDS 

Desirable 

• Security experience working in Hybrid Cloud environments 

• Previous security work with PCI DSS compliant environment

records.title: Graduate Quantitative Developer
records.officialDescription:
DeepFin is a systematic proprietary trading firm combining deep learning, traditional quantitative research methods, and cutting-edge trading technology, to trade global markets. Founded by engineers and researchers, we build and deploy advanced trading systems that operate across global markets.

Our team is lean, highly technical, and impact-driven - every hire plays a direct role in shaping the firm’s technology, strategy, and performance. We value curiosity, precision, and collaboration, and we’re building an environment where exceptional people can do their best work at the intersection of AI and financial markets.

Junior Quant Developer - Backtesting, Simulation & Research, Productionise Research (C++/Python)

Role Overview

We’re hiring a junior Quant Developer to help productionise research into robust, high-performance trading systems. You’ll work closely with Quant Researchers and senior engineers to convert Python research code into production C++, build and optimise backtesting / simulation infrastructure, and support strategy development using L3 market data across multiple venues.

This is a hands-on, engineering-heavy role in a fast-moving environment: you’ll own components end-to-end and contribute directly to research velocity and trading PnL.

Key Responsibilities

• Productionise research models into C++: translate Python prototypes into efficient, maintainable C++ production code.

• Backtesting & simulation: build and improve simulation systems that reflect real market mechanics (order book, fills, cancels, exchange rules).

• L3 market data handling: ingest and process high-volume tick/order-level feeds; create reliable feature pipelines from raw exchange data.

• Performance optimisation: improve latency and throughput of backtests/sims (profiling, memory optimisation, data structures, parallelism where appropriate).

• Research support tooling: create utilities for data inspection, experiment tracking, run orchestration, and post-trade analytics in Python.

• Debugging & correctness: investigate mismatches between simulation and production behaviour; diagnose edge cases and implement fixes with strong test coverage.

• Cross-team collaboration: work daily with researchers and infra/exec engineers to ship improvements from idea → test → production.

Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s from a top university in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Physics, or similar.

• 0-3 years experience in quantitative finance or other relevant data-intensive industries working with C++

• Strong working knowledge of C++ (memory, ownership, STL, performance-aware coding).

• Experience: demonstrable evidence of hands-on systems work in C++ handling large-scale data (internships, research labs, competitive projects, open-source).

• Comfortable with Python for analysis, tooling, and debugging (pandas/numpy/Jupyter a plus).

• Exposure to quantitative finance, eg through internships/university societies, including market microstructure and L3/order book data.

• Clear “builder mindset”: you like owning problems end-to-end, shipping incrementally, and iterating quickly.

If you’re passionate about applying advanced technology to real-world markets and want to work alongside a focused, high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you. DeepFin offers a collaborative, research-driven environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution and where every contribution has visible impact.

Join us in building the next generation of deep-learning-driven trading systems - shaping the future of finance through innovation, rigour, and technology.

records.title: AI Engineer (India)
records.officialDescription:
We are expanding our agentic AI capability and are looking for an AI Engineer to join the team. You will work alongside senior engineers to build and maintain AI systems - contributing to agentic pipelines, retrieval infrastructure, and the integrations that tie these systems together.

This is a hands-on implementation role with real ownership of components. You will grow your skills in a fast-moving AI practice, working on production systems that directly affect client outcomes.

What This Involves:

• Build and maintain agentic pipelines and workflows under the guidance of senior engineers: tool use, orchestration, and multi-step reasoning.

• Implement and tune RAG pipelines - including embedding, chunking strategies, vector retrieval, and retrieval evaluation.

• Contribute to memory and context layer components: integrating vector databases, supporting knowledge graph pipelines, and helping maintain state management across agentic systems.

• Write clean, well-tested Python code and participate in code reviews.

• Debug and improve existing AI systems based on evaluation results and production feedback.

• Collaborate with data engineers and domain experts to integrate AI components with upstream data sources and downstream applications.

• Document implementations clearly and contribute to shared internal tooling.

Requirements: 

• 2-4 years of software or ML engineering experience, with at least 1 year working with LLMs or AI systems in a professional setting.

• Working knowledge of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and at least one agentic or RAG framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent).

• Solid Python skills and comfort with software engineering basics: version control, testing, REST APIs.

• Familiarity with vector databases or embedding-based search.

• Curiosity about agentic AI - you follow developments in the space and are eager to apply new techniques.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills - comfortable working across cross-functional and client-facing teams.

• Ability to overlap with Pacific Time business hours for a minimum of 3 hours per day.

Key Competencies: 

• Stakeholder Mentality: Treats the company's and client’s goals as their own and is genuinely motivated by its success.

• Organisational Excellence: Manages time and priorities effectively, ensuring tasks are completed accurately and on time even in a fast-paced environment.

• Discretion & Integrity: Handles sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and sound judgement.

• Problem Solving: Approaches challenges proactively and with a solution-oriented mindset, taking initiative rather than waiting to be directed.

• Collaboration: A team player who builds strong working relationships and communicates effectively with colleagues across all levels.

Why You Will Love It Here: 

• Work on real-world AI and advanced analytics solutions with measurable business impact.

• Collaborate with a global team of engineers and data scientists.

• Exposure to diverse industries, modern cloud platforms, and cutting-edge AI technologies.

• A collaborative culture that values real outcomes.

• Rapid learning opportunities and diverse challenges.

• Flat organisational hierarchy with high visibility and accessibility to our leaders.

About Fam (previously FamPay) Fam is India's first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ youngest users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life. Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors. About the Role We are looking for a Security Enthusiast who thinks like a hacker but works for the good guys. You shouldn't just find bugs; you should be obsessed with understanding why they exist and how to fix them for good. As an Application Security Engineer Intern, you will be the first line of defense for the Fam. You will break things before the bad guys do, automate security checks, and work side-by-side with our engineering team to build a fortress around our users' hard-earned money. If you get a rush from finding an RCE, live on r/netsec, or spend your weekends capturing flags or bounties, this role is for you. Note: This is an onsite internship at Fam HQ, Bangalore. Curious to know about FamPay's tech stack? Click here to know what makes and keeps Fam running!

On the Job 
• Break the App: Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing (VAPT) on our Web Applications, Android/iOS Apps, and APIs.

• Automate Defense: Help integrate security tools (SAST/DAST) into our CI/CD pipelines. We believe security should move as fast as our code.

• Code Review: Review source code for security flaws (like SQLi, XSS, IDOR) and help developers write secure code from day one.

• Bug Triage: Analyze incoming bug reports from our Bug Bounty programs, validate them, and prioritize fixes.

• Threat Modeling: Work with product and engineering teams during the design phase to identify potential security risks before a single line of code is written.

• Learn & Evolve: Stay updated with the latest CVEs, zero-days, and security trends.
Who you are
• The Hacker Mindset: You have a deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 (Web & Mobile) and know how to exploit and patch them.

• Tool Wizardry: Hands-on experience with tools like Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Postman, or similar open-source security tools.

• Coding Chops: You can read code (Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript) and write scripts to automate attacks or defenses.

• Curiosity: You are a student of the game. You actively participate in CTFs, Bug Bounties, or have a rank on platforms like HackTheBox/TryHackMe.

• Communication: You can explain a complex vulnerability to a developer without sounding like a robot.
Bonus Points
• Experience with Cloud Security (AWS/GCP).

• A Hall of Fame mention in any major tech company's Bug Bounty program.

• Open source security contributions.
Why Join Us?
• Impact: You’ll be protecting the financial data of millions of teenagers. The bugs you find and fix will have a direct, real-world impact.

• Mentorship: Work directly with founding members and senior engineers who have built systems at scale.

• Perks: Competitive stipend, Certificate and Letter of Recommendation, Friendly leave policy, and cool Fam merchandise!

Ready to be part of the Fam? Apply Now and complete this challenge - https://ctf.fampay.co/

Beghou brings over three decades of experience helping life sciences companies optimize their commercialization through strategic insight, advanced analytics, and technology. From developing go-to-market strategies and building foundational data analytics infrastructures to leveraging artificial intelligence to improve customer insights and engagement, Beghou helps life sciences companies maximize performance across their portfolios. • Follow the team's established design patterns, architectural guidelines, and Microsoft framework best practices

• Adhere to coding standards, participate in code reviews, and incorporate feedback from senior engineers

Preferred Qualifications

At Beghou Consulting, you'll join a highly collaborative, values-driven team where technical excellence, analytical rigor, and personal growth converge. Whether you're passionate about AI innovation, building commercialization strategies, or shaping the next generation of data-first solutions in life sciences, this is a place to make an impact!

records.title: Forward Deployed Engineer

Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers. We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about. Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number. We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the whole job for a customer: understand the problem, design the solution, build it with Claude Code and other AI coding tools, roll it out, and keep it running.
This is a hands-on role that sits close to the customer. You will talk to them, understand how their business works, and turn that into software they use every day. You own what you build, from the first line of code to live in production.

You will not be one small cog in a large system. You will ship whole things.

This role is for you if -

• Work with customers and internal teams to scope what to build next

records.officialDescription:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup building a real-time transportation visibility platform for global supply chains. We help shippers, manufacturers, and logistics service providers turn data into decisions and decisions into measurable business impact. Our platform goes beyond visibility. Portcast enables action at scale by surfacing the right risks early, helping teams prevent detention and demurrage, accelerate exception management, and close invoices faster with built-in evidence. We turn visibility into outcomes: reduced costs, improved operational control, and more predictable supply chains. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to make supply chains not just visible, but decisively actionable: end to end. ABOUT THE ROLE: Portcast has already been used by global freight forwarding companies, manufacturers and cargo airlines. Our customers trust us to deliver fast, reliable and secure predictions, our engine answers when, where, why, and by how many days a container will be delayed. That trust lives or dies on data quality, and that's what you'll own. As our Data Analyst, you will be reporting directly to our Analytics Manager and work closely with our Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams. You'll sit on a data-heavy product that gives customers end-to-end visibility of their cargo across the ocean journey, making sure the data we ingest into the models and share with customers is error-free and of the highest quality. You won't just run the query and close the ticket here. When an anomaly shows up, you'll chase why it's there, trace it to the real source, and fix the process so it doesn't come back. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:
• 
Documentation, reporting, and root-cause analysis of prediction issues: owning the problem end to end, not just flagging it.

• 
Analyze ingested and system-generated data for anomalies and gaps, and refer to various data sources to plug those gaps.

• 
Turn data into stories: surface the pattern behind an issue, propose the fix (QA process-flow change and/or automation), and own the subsequent plan and execution.

• 
Automate performance/accuracy review processes, report generation, and data visualization using Python and SQL: building reusable, scalable workflows, not one-off scripts.

• 
Support Engineering and Data Science on system-level data fixes. Understand how the engine makes predictions, and explore improvements by fixing or introducing new data and features.

• 
Support Customer Operations and Marketing with insights from the data: performance, accuracy metrics, the impact of real-time events, as needed.

• 
Maintain and own internal and customer dashboards based on trial/account requirements (prediction accuracy, timeliness, coverage, explainability).
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 
At least 2-3+ years in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role, preferably in a product-based, lean startup particularly in logistics, ecommerce or B2B SaaS data-heavy domain. 

• 
Exceptionally skilled in Python and SQL, with a demonstrated ability to consistently produce reusable and highly scalable code.

• 
An eye for detail: you go looking for anomalies in the system before a customer does, and proven experience turning messy data into clear visualizations.

• 
First Principles Thinker: when you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new tool when…

records.title: AI Generalist Intern
records.officialDescription:
About HexCoded HexCoded is an AI video studio: you should be able to make anything you can imagine. We're a very small team, based in Gurugram and working remotely, building the tools that are reshaping how video, image and audio get made. You'd work directly with me. Small team means nothing sits between you and the thing that ships.

What you'll actually work on
• Live in the product. Your first week is spent making real videos in Creative Studio, across our video and image models, until you know where it breaks. Then you tell us - specifically, with the fix, not just the complaint.

• Own a fix end to end. Find the thing that loses us users, argue for it, spec it tightly enough to build, and build the parts you can. You will ship to production in your first month.

• Know the models cold. Sixteen video and image models sit in one place. Learn what each is good at, what it costs and where it falls over - and be the person who can say which one to reach for, and why.

• Talk to users. On calls, on chat, in their own words. Bring back what they actually said, not a summary of what we hoped they said.

• Know the market better than its own marketing pages. What every competing tool costs, what it does better than us, and where we win.

• Whatever is on fire. Some weeks that is a vendor, a spreadsheet, a hiring pipeline or a launch. This is the honest part of the job.
What you'll bring
• You have built something real with AI. Not a tutorial - a thing that exists, that someone other than you has used. Whether you hand-wrote the code or drove a model to write it matters far less than whether it works and whether you can walk us through how.

• You check the machine's work. You can point at a time AI confidently handed you something wrong, and say how you caught it. "It didn't get anything wrong" is the wrong answer.

• You read a product like an owner. You notice the thing that costs a user money or time, and you can say what you would do about it - precisely enough that someone could go build it.

• High agency. You close loops without being chased. Given a half-formed problem and no instructions, you come back with it handled - or with the one question that was actually blocking you.

• Clear, short writing. Most of your output is words other people act on. Long and vague is worse than short and wrong.

• Speed over polish. You would rather ship ten rough things this week than one perfect thing next month.

• Six months, full time, remote. Final-year student or a 2026 graduate. Any degree.

How to apply

• Open Creative Studio and make something first. Sign up, generate one video, and find where it frustrates you. Then apply and tell us the single thing you'd fix - and how you'd build it.

• That paragraph is what we read first. A CV is fine, but it is not what decides this. Applications that clearly have not opened the product do not get past the first pass.

Job Summary
The Associate Implementation Engineer works directly with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning both the product configuration and the underlying data migration that make each implementation successful. This role confirms requirements, configures and tests the platform, migrates and validates customer data, and trains users, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live.
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and strong data and database expertise, the Associate Implementation Engineer understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including database schema management, ETL configuration, and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach, and partners across teams to ensure a smooth, high-quality implementation that maximizes the value customers realize from OpenGov.
Responsibilities

• Deploy, configure, and test OpenGov cloud software to meet the documented implementation requirements of governments across the United States

• Own customer data migration end to end, including database schema management, ETL tool configuration, and scripting as required, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated customer data

• Confirm customer requirements across both configuration and data, and provide guidance, assistance, and support throughout the platform configuration and integration process

records.title: Offensive Security & Threat Hunting Engineer
records.officialDescription:
ABOUT US 
Glomo builds cross-border payment infrastructure. Our network connects local payment rails across countries, so customers move money across borders in seconds. We are a licensed Payment Service Provider at GIFT IFSC, regulated by IFSCA, and the first of our kind in India. We are also a Visa Principal Member, the first non-bank acquirer in India to join the network, so we acquire and process Visa card payments directly. The team behind Glomo has more than 100 years of combined experience in building large payment products.

YOUR IMPACT
Glomo moves real money across borders and handles card data and customer KYC records. That makes us a target. This role exists to find the ways into our systems before an attacker does, and to catch the ones who get in anyway. You split your time between offence and hunting. On offence, you test our cloud, APIs, networks, and employee endpoints the way a real attacker would. On the hunting side, you work through endpoint, network, and identity logs for what our alerts missed. You work alongside the IT and Infrastructure team and see each finding through to the fix. Your testing also backs our PCI-DSS and regulatory audits.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Penetration testing. Run regular internal and external tests across our networks, cloud environments, APIs, and employee endpoints to uncover weak points and misconfigurations.
Threat hunting. Dig through endpoint telemetry (EDR), network logs, and identity provider logs for unauthorised access, lateral movement, and anomalies that our automated alerts did not catch.
Adversary simulation and purple teaming. Simulate realistic attacks, including credential theft, phishing, and AI-assisted attacks, then work with our IT and Infrastructure team to close the gaps you find.
Automation. Write scripts and use AI-assisted security tools so that vulnerability discovery and attack surface monitoring run continuously. 
Reporting. Write up each finding so that an engineer can act on it: what you did, what it exposes, and how to fix it, in priority order. No bloated, copy-pasted scanner reports.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING
Experience. 3+ years of hands-on work in penetration testing, red teaming, or threat hunting.
Endpoint and network depth. You know Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud identity attacks, and how Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools work.
Tooling and scripting. You are comfortable with Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Metasploit, you write SIEM and EDR queries, and you script in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
AI awareness. You know how attackers use AI, for example for automated recon, you can test LLM and API security, and you use automation to scale your own testing.
Practical credentials. Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, CRTO, PNPT, or GCTI matter more to us than a purely theoretical degree.

GOOD TO HAVE

• An active bug bounty profile on HackerOne or Bugcrowd

• Open-source security tools that you built or contribute to

• Security testing in payments or fintech, including PCI-DSS penetration test requirements

• GCP and Kubernetes attack paths

• Detection engineering: turning hunt findings into alert rules

WHY JOIN US
High autonomy
You own how we test, harden, and monitor our entire technical footprint.
Builder culture
Your findings go straight to the engineers who fix them. No endless bureaucracy.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

• Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company, where your work directly sets our direction

• Accelerated career growth: we invest in your development

• Competitive compensation with equity ownership

• Comprehensive health insurance, flexible time off, and a professional development budget

• A close team that celebrates wins and supports each other

Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.
This is a paid 6-month internship with the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at the end based on performance. You'll build the interfaces enterprise users interact with every day, shipping real features to real customers from your first sprint, with real ownership and direct mentorship from senior engineers.

What You'll Do

• Build UI components: Develop pixel-perfect, highly interactive UI components in React.

• Turn designs into code: Translate Figma designs into production-ready code, and push back when the design doesn't make sense.

• Own performance: Care about load times, re-renders, and bundle sizes.

• Collaborate on APIs: Work with backend engineers to define APIs and data contracts.

• Ship end-to-end with quality: Write component tests, maintain a high standard for code quality, and ship features end-to-end, not just the "frontend part."

What You'll Need

• JS/TS fundamentals: A solid grasp of JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals: closures, async, and the event loop.

• React: Working knowledge of React: hooks, state management, and component lifecycle.

• Real project experience: You've shipped something real to the web (even if small) and gone beyond tutorials: thoughtful state management (what lives where and why), API integration with loading/error/auth handling, forms with client- and server-aware validation, multi-page routing (nested and protected routes, query params), or working with a component library or design system.

• Debugging & performance: You can look at a broken UI and fix it without being told where to start, and you've used browser DevTools to spot and fix a slow render.

• Quality & UX: You care about accessibility, responsiveness, and edge cases, not just happy paths, and you have opinions about UX that you're not afraid to voice.

• AI-assisted building: You use AI tools (Copilot, v0, or similar) to build faster, and know when a suggestion is right and when it's subtly wrong.

Internship Details & What You Get

• Duration: A paid 6-month internship, with the opportunity to transition to a full-time role at the end based on performance.

• Compensation: Competitive compensation, benchmarked above market for fresher roles.

• The work: Complex, high-stakes enterprise UIs - enterprise software done right - with your code shipping to real customers quickly.

• Mentorship & impact: Direct mentorship from senior engineers who push you to grow fast, and real ownership from day one.

Location
Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

• London

• San Francisco

• Jaipur
The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

• Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

• Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

records.title: Machine Learning Engineer
records.officialDescription:
Role Description
We are seeking an experienced machine learning engineer to join our seasoned founding team to drive the development and innovation of our ML platform. Ideal candidates bring extensive experience in building the next generation of machine learning models and its training and serving infrastructure for the Spector.
This role requires a hands-on engineer who is passionate about our mission, thrives in a startup environment, and is committed to pushing the boundaries of what ML and GenAI can achieve in industrial resilience.

You will:

• Create ML models which help drive value for users and our company.

• Build scalable ML model training and serving infrastructure.

• Evaluate the technical tradeoffs of every decision.

• Perform code reviews and ensure exceptional code quality.

• Iterate quickly without compromising quality.
Must Have:

• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science and 3+ years of post-Bachelor’s machine learning experience; or Master’s degree in a technical field + 2+ year of post-grad machine learning experience; or PhD in a relevant technical field + 1 years of post-grad machine learning experience.

• Experience developing machine learning models for supervised, unsupervised, ranking, or other relevant applications of machine learning.

• Strong understanding of machine learning approaches and algorithms.

• Experience working with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Spark ML, scikit-learn, or related frameworks.

• Ability to work with both internal and external partners.

• Strong collaboration and mentorship skills.

• Entrepreneurial Mindset: Highly self motivated and adaptable with a passion for innovation, problem-solving, and making a meaningful impact in a startup environment.

• Willingness to take ownership and drive projects from concept to implementation.
Preferred to have:

• Experience in on-prem ML model deployment and observability.

• Experience in building and deploying ML models for real time time series data like sensor/IoT data.
About Spector.ai
Spector.ai is a well-funded, fast-paced, innovative seed-stage startup focused on a mission to solve the $1.5 trillion challenge of industrial asset reliability. Spector is building an AI-first industrial agent platform designed to transform plant reliability and performance from reactive to autonomous operations. By combining machine learning and domain-specific industrial AI Agents, Spector.ai enables real-time diagnostics, root cause analysis, and actionable recommendations at scale. The platform extracts insights from complex industrial data including unstructured documentation and live sensor streams reducing false positives, shortening time to resolution, and scaling expertise without reliance on data scientists.
We are rapidly growing and looking for an experienced, self-driven DevOps Engineer to join our core team. This is a unique opportunity to shape our infrastructure, tooling, and deployment practices from the ground up, ensuring we can scale effectively and reliably as we move toward our next stage of funding and growth.
