records.officialDescription:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Research Engineer to build applied NLP and LLM systems for healthcare and oncology workflows. You will work on real-world clinical text, information extraction, patient-trial matching, summarization, RWE abstraction, and structured outputs from clinical documents.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on model development, experimentation, evaluation, and building practical ML systems that can eventually move toward production.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Build prototypes and production-oriented components for clinical information extraction and LLM workflows.

• Implement prompts, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning experiments, extraction logic, evaluation scripts, and error-analysis tools.

• Work with senior engineers to improve model quality, robustness, and reliability.

• Analyze clinical-text model failures and propose meaningful improvements.

• Collaborate with Clinical AI Data Specialists to understand labeling guidelines, data quality issues, and clinical edge cases.

• Collaborate with ML Evaluation Engineers to run benchmark and regression tests.

• Write clean, tested, maintainable Python code and contribute to internal tools, data processing scripts, and annotation/evaluation workflows.

WHAT WE EXPECT

• 1.5-4 years of hands-on experience in ML, NLP, LLMs, or data-intensive software engineering.

• Strong Python programming skills and willingness to work with messy real-world data.

• Familiarity with PyTorch, HuggingFace, embeddings, transformers, RAG, prompt engineering, and basic fine-tuning.

• Good understanding of precision/recall/F1, train/validation/test splits, overfitting, error analysis, and experiment tracking.

• Ability to learn clinical domain concepts and ask clarifying questions about labels and data.

• Strong ownership of assigned modules and tasks.

• Exposure to Docker, APIs, ML deployment, MLflow/W&B, or data pipelines.

We replace that manual work with task-driven AI agents that sit inside the EMR and process records at scale, in real time.
Our platform is trusted by leading cancer centers including Memorial Sloan Kettering, Mount Sinai, and Yale Cancer Center. We have grown 10x in the last year and process millions of oncology medical documents monthly.
Our investors include Battery Ventures, Lightspeed, General Catalyst, Nexus Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

Why Join Triomics

• Impact at scale. The systems your teams build directly power AI workflows that accelerate cancer research and improve patient outcomes.

• Cutting-edge problems. Hard, data-intensive systems at the intersection of AI, healthcare, and scale - in a highly regulated industry where reliability is non-negotiable.

• World-class team. Work alongside top talent across AI, engineering, and product, with best-in-industry compensation.

• Culture that ships. Fast-paced, ownership-driven, with company-sponsored workations.

GTM Coordinator, Cloud Native (Talent Pool)
Talent Pooling Opportunity
We are currently building a talent pool for this role and welcoming applications from candidates who may be interested in joining us in early Q4. Please note that this is a forward-planning recruitment process, so there may be a delay in responding to applications. We appreciate your patience and will be in touch with suitable candidates as the process progresses.
About the role
Percona is hiring a GTM Coordinator to support go-to-market execution for our Cloud Native product line: PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB Kubernetes Operators. You will work alongside the Product Marketing Manager / GTM Owner to keep launches, campaigns, content, and community programs running on time and organized, giving you hands-on exposure to product marketing for a Kubernetes-native, open source product line.
What you'll do

• Coordinate launch logistics for new releases, features, and service offerings: timelines, checklists, cross-team follow-ups, and asset tracking.

• Help build and maintain GTM assets, including web page updates, datasheets, case studies, and sales enablement materials, working from briefs provided by the PMM/GTM Owner.

• Support community, partner, and customer engagement activity, including coordinating interviews, gathering testimonials, and organizing case study material.

• Maintain and organize customer evidence: interview notes, quotes, proof points, and research inputs.

• Track campaign performance data and help prepare reporting on segmentation and demand generation results.

• Coordinate with Digital Marketing on scheduling and asset delivery for content, SEO, PPC, email, and social channels.

• Support event and CFP logistics for Kubernetes and database community events (submission tracking, deadlines, speaker coordination)
What you'll bring

• An interest in tech marketing.

• 1+ years of experience in a marketing, GTM, or coordination role.

• Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple deadlines and stakeholders at once.

• Good writing skills and attention to detail.

• Basic comfort with data: pulling numbers together, spotting patterns, building simple reports.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken).

• A proactive mindset: comfortable asking questions, following up, and keeping things moving without needing every step spelt out.

Why Percona?
At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce - we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!

records.title: Backend Engineer – GTM Engineering (Fresh grad, India)
records.officialDescription:
Please do not contact anyone at Secfix by email, phone, or LinkedIn about this role. We only accept applications submitted through the form on our careers page, and messages sent any other way will not be answered.

Location: 100% Remote from India, min. 4h overlap with CET (e.g. 9:00-13:00 CET). Fluent English, spoken and written. German is not required.
Compensation: 20k-32k USD per year (depending on location) + Shares + Generous Benefits. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.
About Secfix
Secfix automates security compliance for SMBs and mid-market companies in Europe and gets them compliant with ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX and SOC 2 in weeks instead of months. We’re a fast-growing team of 36 people, backed by a $12M Series A from Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank) and Bayern Capital.
About the Role
You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our go-to-market team. You build and own the backend systems our BDRs and AEs run on every day: data pipelines, integrations, internal services and AI agents. Today, everyone runs their own setup for data, outreach and communication. You’ll replace that with one central, reliable system that scales with us. This is a hands-on engineering role: you’ll write code (Python, SQL) every day, connect APIs and build data pipelines and AI workflows, not configure tools or run RevOps. You report to our Head of GTM, work closely with Sales and exchange with our Engineering team on architecture and best practices. We own products and outcomes, not Jira tickets.
What You'll Do

• Data pipelines: Design and build pipelines that pull account and contact data from multiple sources and APIs, clean, deduplicate and score it, and sync it to our CRM as the single source of truth.

• Data layer: Design the data model and central database behind our GTM, connecting CRM, outreach and product data.

• Integrations & services: Integrate internal and third-party tools via REST APIs and webhooks, and build small internal services and tools where off-the-shelf tools fall short.

• Signals & automation: Build signal detection, lead scoring and routing, and alerts that tell the right rep which account to call today and why.

• AI agents: Build AI-powered tools and agents that take repetitive work off our AEs, from research to proposals to CRM updates.

• Reliability: Deploy, schedule, monitor and maintain everything you build: error handling, retries, rate limits, logging and alerts when something breaks.

• Ownership end-to-end: Investigate problems, find the root cause, ship the fix and document it so nothing depends on one person.
Your success: reps spend less time on manual work and more time with customers, and more pipeline comes from systems that run reliably and are actually used.
About You
You’re a backend engineer who loves building things real people use every day, and curious about the business: why a customer buys, which signal means a company is ready. You build systems that run reliably at 10x volume, not one-off scripts.

• Recent graduate (0-2 years) in Computer Science or a related engineering field with a strong academic record.

• 1+ years of backend experience through your first full-time job or internships in a startup environment.

• Strong engineering fundamentals: solid Python (or another backend language), SQL and data modeling.

• Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with webhooks.

• You know how to run code in production: Git, deployment, scheduling, testing, logging and debugging.

Secfix automates security compliance for SMBs and mid-market companies in Europe and gets them compliant with ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX and SOC 2 in weeks instead of months. We’re a fast-growing team of 36 people, backed by a $12M Series A from Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank) and Bayern Capital.

You’ll be our first GTM Engineer and build the system our entire go-to-market team runs on, from BDRs to AEs. Today, everyone runs their own setup for data, outreach and communication. This is a hands-on engineering role: you’ll write code (Python, SQL) every day, connect APIs and build data pipelines and AI workflows, not configure tools or run RevOps. HackSprint 3.0 brings together passionate developers, designers, problem-solvers, and innovators from across India to transform creative ideas into impactful, technology-driven solutions. It provides a platform to experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate with like-minded innovators, and tackle real-world challenges. **Mode:** Online Preliminary Round + Offline Final Round **Final Venue:** Karpagam Academy of Higher Education (KAHE), Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu **Final Hackathon Duration:** 36 Hours **Application Deadline:** 28 December 2026 📢 **PPT Submission Template:** Will be announced soon! # 🛠️ How It Works ## Round 1: Online Idea Submission & Screening The first round will be conducted online. Following the evaluation, selected teams will be shortlisted for the final round. **Important:** Submitting an application does not guarantee participation in the final hackathon. Only shortlisted teams will be invited to the offline round. ## Round 2: Offline Final Hackathon Shortlisted teams will participate in the **36-hour offline hackathon** at Karpagam Academy of Higher Education, Coimbatore. Participants will develop their proposed solutions, build prototypes, test their implementations, and present their projects to the judging panel. Final evaluation will focus on innovation, technical implementation, functionality, feasibility, problem-solving, and overall impact. 📅 **Final-round dates will be announced once confirmed.** # 🌟 HackSprint 3.0 Tracks ### 🌱 Agrotech Leverage technology to address agricultural challenges through smart irrigation, precision farming, AI-enabled agriculture, resource optimization, and sustainable farming solutions. ### 🏥 MedTech Develop technology-driven healthcare solutions focused on diagnostics, remote healthcare, medical accessibility, patient monitoring, and improved healthcare delivery. ### 🎓 EduTech Reimagine education through digital learning platforms, adaptive learning systems, skill-development tools, inclusive education, and innovative teaching technologies. ### 🐯 WildVisionTech Explore AI- and ML-powered solutions for wildlife conservation, anti-poaching intelligence, environmental monitoring, and biodiversity protection. ### 💡 Open Innovation Think without boundaries. ## 🚀 Season 5 is cleared for launch. **TecHacks 5.0** is Season 05 of TecHacks: one **24-hour hackathon, fully in person**, on one stage at Chitkara University, Punjab. Form a crew, pick a track and turn an idea into a working solution in one night, in one room. Learn from mentors, meet like-minded builders and pitch to the judges. Food and rest on campus for all 24 hours. ### 🎒 Bring Laptop, charger, an extension board and a valid ID. Hardware is not provided (sponsored kits only; email hi@techacks.tech to check). # CODERAVE 2.0 ## National-Level Hybrid Hackathon **Organized by Internwell SLIET Club** **Venue:** Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab **Mode:** Hybrid — Online (All India) + Offline (SLIET Campus) ### About the Hackathon Coderave 2.0 is a national-level hybrid hackathon designed to bring together innovative minds, passionate developers, designers, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful technology solutions. Organized by Internwell SLIET Club, this edition offers students an opportunity to demonstrate their creativity, technical expertise, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities through a competitive, time-bound development experience. The hackathon welcomes teams from colleges and universities across India through its online participation track, while SLIET students can participate in the offline campus track. Shortlisted teams will present their ideas through PPT pitches, followed by an intensive 24-hour open-source development challenge in which participants will build, test, and demonstrate their solutions. Whether you are interested in web development, app development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, or other emerging technologies, Coderave 2.0 is your platform to innovate, collaborate, and compete. ### Participation Tracks **1. Online Track — All India** - Open to eligible student teams from colleges and universities across India. - Register online and submit your project proposal PPT. - A maximum of 20 teams(not confirm) will be shortlisted nationally for the online track. - Shortlisted teams will pitch their PPT to the judges through an online meeting platform or offline. - Selected teams(only 5 team) will participate in the 24-hour development challenge remotely, from their preferred location. - Finalists will submit their source code repository, project documentation, and demo video for evaluation. - Online participants may be invited to attend the offline campus event if feasible and communicated by the organizers. **2. Offline Track — SLIET Campus** - Open to eligible students of SLIET, Longowal. - Register online and submit the project proposal PPT during registration. - Shortlisted teams will present their PPT in person on campus on 13 February. - The offline 24-hour hackathon(both online and offline track ) will begin at 5:00 PM on 13 February and conclude at 5:00 PM on 14 February. - Teams will develop and demonstrate their solutions according to the official rules and submission instructions. ### Team Formation and Eligibility - Minimum team size: 3 members. - Maximum team size: 6 members. - Each team must include at least 1 girl member(max 3 girls). - One member must be designated as the Team Leader. - **The Team Leader will complete the registration on behalf of the entire team and provide accurate details for every member.** - Each participant may belong to only one registered team. - All team members must meet the eligibility requirements announced by the organizers. ### Registration and Selection Process **Round 1 — Registration and PPT Submission:** The Team Leader registers the complete team and submits the project proposal PPT. **Round 2 — PPT Evaluation and Shortlisting:** Judges evaluate submissions based on innovation, problem relevance, feasibility, technical approach, potential impact, and presentation quality. **Round 3 — PPT Pitch:** Shortlisted online teams(Max 20 team) pitch through an online meeting. > # **All that you need to know about Eclipse 7.0** **ECLIPSE 7.0** is the flagship event of the ACM Student Chapter, TIET, and a premier **24-hour hackathon** that draws participation from across the nation. As the chapter’s most distinguished and celebrated initiative, it serves as a dynamic platform for developers, designers, and innovators to collaborate and compete. With expert-led workshops, dedicated mentorship, and an intense build environment, **ECLIPSE 7.0** is designed to cultivate innovation, enhance technical excellence, and transform ambitious ideas into impactful, real-world solutions. > **Eligibility:** • The hackathon is open to students from all Colleges and Universities. • Students from all academic years are eligible to participate. Teams may include members from different colleges. • Participants from diverse specializations are welcome to form teams together. > **Team Format:** **Teams must consist of 2–5 members.** Participants are advised to form teams with complementary expertise, including design, frontend development, backend development, and database management. > **Problem Statements:** Each team must choose only ONE problem statement. The detailed problem statements will be published in the PDF below and simultaneously made accessible on the ECLIPSE 7.0 website and ACM’s official social media platforms. > **Rounds & Duration:** **Round 1:** Pre-Screening Round (Online): Teams will be shortlisted based on their idea presentation. **Round 2:** Offline Hackathon Round: Shortlisted teams will participate in the on-site hackathon. During the offline round, teams will be assessed at regular checkpoints to ensure consistent progress. All rounds must be completed within the officially communicated timelines. > **Attendance:** Physical attendance at the venue is mandatory for all qualifying participants. > **Required submissions for the offline round include:** A code repository link and/or deployed project link and a project proposal document > **Rules:** • Teams must register exclusively through Devfolio and provide accurate team and member details. • Teams will be evaluated only on the problem statement they have selected. Working on multiple problem statements is strictly prohibited. • The prototype must be developed strictly during the offline round. Pre-built solutions will result in disqualification. • Plagiarism is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification. • All submissions must be original. • All participants are required to join the official event application and community platform. Failure to comply may result in disqualification. • Participants must strictly follow the Code of Conduct throughout the event. • Any form of misconduct or rule violation may result in disqualification at the discretion of the organizing committee. • Projects will be evaluated by a panel of judges.
